title: Especialista de Modelagem Hidráulica Pleno
description:
A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.

Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.

A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir autonomamente estudos hidráulicos para sistemas de abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário.
  • Elaborar e validar documentação técnica de estudos internos e de terceiros.
  • Desenvolver análises, cenários críticos e estudos de ampliação em sistemas de água e esgoto.
  • Executar e validar calibrações de modelos hidráulicos com base em dados monitorados.
  • Participar da análise de viabilidade econômica de soluções técnicas de infraestrutura.
  • Atuar em demandas de novos negócios da companhia, com foco técnico na modelagem.
  • Integrar informações de campo e dados geoespaciais (GIS) aos modelos.
  • Contribuir em grupos de trabalho e iniciativas de evolução técnica da área.

Requisitos

  • Ensino superior completo em Engenharia Civil, Sanitária, Ambiental ou correlatas.
  • Experiência prática em modelagem hidráulica (construção, calibração, setorização, cenários e ampliação).
  • Domínio de softwares como WaterCAD, SewerCAD, Hammer, Epanet ou similares.
  • Conhecimento intermediário/avançado em Excel.
  • Conhecimento em GIS (QGIS ou ArcGIS).
  • Experiência com projetos de saneamento.
  • Capacidade analítica, organização, proatividade e comunicação eficaz.
  • Disponibilidade para viagens pontuais.

Diferenciais

The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer solves complex problems and uses discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services.   • Communicate and explain complex issues and work to establish understanding
  • Provide engineering support onboard installation vessels offshore, when required to do so
  • Be fully familiar with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter-discipline requirements; including identifying concerns as early as practicable and taking appropriate initiatives to address the issues
  • Identify changes to scope and promptly raise change notifications, including providing any necessary supporting documentation and estimates Provide similar support for Variation Orders
  • Interface with all disciplines to develop clash free designs
  • Interface with other departments to obtain input for discipline designs and drawings
  • Maintain close cooperation with other engineering disciplines, Planning, Fabrication, Marine, and Project Management Teams, as required
  • Document substantive communications (communications that result in significant decisions or assignment of actions) and forward copies to the Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in the preparation of estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and workhour estimates
  • Raise technical queries to obtain missing information, clarify work scope, and maintain preferred McDermott procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements
  • Prepare Discipline engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications, as required
  • Participate in finalizing deliverables lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity
  • Attend project review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys, as required
  • Provide technical direction and review of Designers producing products related to Construction/Installation Support Engineering
  • Prepare and review design reports
  • Assist in providing necessary design inputs to other disciplines to enable them to proceed with their deliverables
  • When assigned, assist procurement personnel in producing Discipline equipment, materials, and services; ensuring that work produced complies with customer objectives and procedures Procurement assistance includes preparing and reviewing requisitions, evaluating technical quotations and preparing queries, compiling bid tabulations and recommendations, preparing purchase requisitions, and coordinating with Procurement to expedite vendor documents, as directed by Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in updating weight report based on receipt of vendor information
  • Check engineering performed by others within the Discipline
  • Perform design verification through single-discipline check/inter-discipline check (IDC)
  • Provide technical support to all fabrication queries, including identifying defect/rectification requirements
  • Keep the Lead engineer apprised of all activities and concerns, technical, budgetary, and manpower related
  • Assist in providing inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity
  • Participate in internal, Customer, and third-party technical audits on engineering deliverables and vendor documents
  • Assist Lead engineer with responses to Customers and other agencies (such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval
  • Capture lessons learned and enter into MDR's Lessons Learned system
  • Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience
  • Guide less experienced engineers on MDR and Discipline procedures, standards, worksheets, design calculations, software, requisitions, technical bid evaluations, technical queries, etc.
  • Be aware of costs related to own work and of the discipline
  • In the Pipeline installation discipline, perform/review Pipeline Installation Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for transportation and installation:
  • Submarine pipelines
  • Risers
  • Spools
  • PLETS and manifolds
  • Cables
  • In the Structural Installation discipline, perform/review Structural Installation Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for loadout, transportation, and installation of offshore structures, including barge upgrades/modifications
  • In the Naval Installation discipline, perform /review Naval Architecture Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures related to all aspects of marine operations covering loadout, transportation, and installation
  • Additional skills (preferred, not mandatory) - perform/review designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures such as:
  • Erection sequences for jackets, topsides, and other structures
  • Loadout procedures and guidance during the operations
  • Construction lift analyses and procedures for activities such as floatover, stackings roll-ups, etc.
  • Weighing procedures
  • Design and detailing of miscellaneous fabrication yard items
  • Crane arrangements and rigging arrangements
  • Trailer arrangements/operations, including drawings and procedures

Reports to: Discipline Lead Engineer

Liaise With: All Engineering disciplines, Fabrication Group, Safety Dept, Document Control, Procurement Group,

Subcontractors, Project Management Team, Vendors, and Customers

Supervises: Engineers

Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Naval Architecture, Civil/Structural/Mechanical Engineering (Master's degree preferred)
  • 8-15 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant predominantly performing construction and installation design
  • Strong working knowledge of many design techniques and analysis methods, and detailed knowledge of the content and application of standards codes and guidelines as applicable for onshore and offshore construction
  • Preferably Registered Professional Engineer or member of a professional engineering society

  • Apoiar a equipe de aquisição de dados durante as operações offshore;
  • Garantir o cumprimento dos procedimentos de segurança e qualidade estabelecidos.

Requisitos:

  • Formação técnica ou superior em Geociências, Geofísica, Oceanografia, Engenharia de Levantamentos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência comprovada em processamento de dados de Multibeam Echo Sounder (MBES);
  • Conhecimento em softwares de processamento e validação de dados (ex.: CARIS HIPS & SIPS, Qimera, EIVA NaviEdit/NaviModel ou equivalentes);
  • Inglês técnico (para leitura e interpretação de relatórios e manuais);
  • Disponibilidade para embarque offshore.

Diferenciais:

  • Experiência em levantamentos hidrográficos em ambiente offshore;
  • Certificações válidas (CBSP, HUET, NR-33, NR-35);
  • Conhecimento em integração de dados geofísicos e geotécnicos.

title: Lead Technical Consultant
description:
Company Overview

At Synamedia, we're a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. With a legacy of protecting our long-time customers, we're laser-focused on driving growth and leading the charge as the industry shifts from Pay-TV to IP and streaming. We are the pioneers in next-gen media cloud services who power the viewing experiences of billions of people on Earth with our best-in-class live streaming, distribution, ad tech, cloud platforms, and more.

Our solutions, built over three decades and trusted by 1,000+ customers, fuel giants like Disney, NBA, The Olympics, Astro, Comcast, Tata Play, and many more.

Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let's do it together!

About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant

Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.
  • Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team
  • Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience of supporting complex projects.
  • Command and control during High Priority Events.
  • Responsible for contribution in refining Service Centre tools and processes.
  • Implement monitoring scripts to prevent repetitive issues.
  • Able to work independently or as part of a team towards complex issue resolutions.
  • Ability to collaborate with customer deployment teams.
  • Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration)
  • Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on ServiceNow ticketing tool.
  • Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.
  • Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.
  • Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.
  • Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.
  • A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.
  • Stay on top of customer reported issues, regularly communicate with customers.

Technical Skills:

  • Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent Linux Systems Administrator.
  • Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).
  • Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.g., Red Hat Cluster.
  • Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (vSphere and vCenter) would be advantageous
  • Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.
  • Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols
  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols FTP.
  • Proven SQL scripting skills.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.
  • Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.
  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.

Qualifications, Experience and Personnal skills:

  • Bachelor's degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Customer focused
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient

Growth Opportunities

When welcoming new talent into the team, we are always looking for opportunities to bring in new ideas, those who ask challenging questions and have the curiosity to learn. These qualities are important to us as we nurture a culture of innovation, seize more opportunities to partner with our customers and make a difference as we transform the future of video. To further support your growth and that of our talent pool, Synamedia offers an exhaustive library of skill enhancement resources from AWS, SkillSoft and other partners to help you upskill while on the job. Be it data analytics that piques your brain or content creation, there's something for every kind of mind.

Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Competitive pay hikes and bonus packages.
  • Skill enhancement and growth opportunities.
  • Equal opportunity employment.
  • Health and wellbeing programmes.
  • Collaborative work with a truly global team.

A Culture of Belonging

Synamedia is committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive and equal opportunity community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed. Our values connect us, and we love to win together. We work with a bias to action, have a bold approach and encourage being deeply curious to grow and evolve, as a team.

In our aim to foster a people-friendly environment, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, engagement activities and services to support all our colleagues across our 20 office locations. Synamedia regularly organises community events that promote cohesion and diversity among colleagues. We are proud of our mental health wellbeing initiatives, our Pride month awareness campaign, our cancer awareness programme and much more.

More information

If this role sparks your interest or any questions, or if you require any accommodations to be made to help you through your application, please reach out to our recruitment team, who would be happy to help.

title: Líder de vendas
description:
Objetivo e Relevância Global para a Organização:

Contribuir para o alcance das metas de KPI da Loja, proporcionando uma experiência memorável para os consumidores e praticando os Valores da Marca. Apoiar a liderança e as operações da loja como terceiro responsável e gerenciar a equipe designada. Utilizar conhecimento e experiência para vender aos consumidores, atendê-los e alcançar excelência operacional, além de executar operações de loja perfeitamente quando for responsável pelo fluxo de produtos entre a área de vendas, o estoque e/ou o caixa, seguindo os procedimentos.

Principais Responsabilidades:

• Apoiar as operações de vendas da loja e os funcionários como terceiro responsável, cumprindo a função de gerente responsável na ausência do Store Manager e do Assistant Store Manager para assegurar o gerenciamento e a supervisão da loja, garantindo o cumprimento dos padrões de atendimento da adidas.

• Colaborar na obtenção dos KPIs da loja e garantir que a equipe tenha ciência deles e da forma como contribuem, e sugerir ajustes necessários para aumentar a produtividade e a eficiência no atendimento e na área de vendas.

• Contribuir para que as políticas e os procedimentos da loja sejam cumpridos de forma a manter um ambiente de trabalho e de compras seguro e apoiar o treinamento da equipe para garantir os padrões da adidas e reduzir riscos.

• Supervisionar e apoiar as diferentes tarefas da loja (por exemplo, caixa, estoque e vendas), executando-as em conjunto com a equipe, se necessário, para garantir o funcionamento da loja e o atendimento ao consumidor.

• Liderar, motivar a equipe designada e apoiar o recrutamento e o treinamento de outros membros da equipe, fornecendo as ferramentas necessárias para ter performance e atingir os objetivos da loja, garantindo o engajamento dos funcionários, a produtividade e a cultura de alta performance, e liderando pelo exemplo enquanto defensor da Marca, demonstrando consistentemente a cultura para reforçar os valores da adidas.

• Apoiar o Store Manager no treinamento da equipe em todas as ferramentas e soluções de vendas digitais e omnicanais, além de prestar atendimento de pós-venda para garantir uma experiência de compra perfeita.

• Concluir todos os programas de treinamento aplicáveis, incluindo Foundational e Seasonal Brand, além de ter conhecimento sobre o produto, colocando o aprendizado na prática com eficácia.

• Trabalhar sempre priorizando a equipe, em total respeito com todos os colegas e contribuindo ativamente para tornar seu local de trabalho um ambiente inclusivo e acolhedor para todos.

Habilidades e Conhecimentos:

• Conhecimento de todas as ferramentas e processos operacionais da loja, do funcionamento da loja e de como atingir os KPIs.

• Compreensão dos padrões de Visual Merchandising para impulsionar a conversão através de ações estratégicas.

• Conectar, engajar e inspirar ativamente os consumidores.

title: Desenhista Cadista
description:

title: Analista de Reforma Tributária Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.

Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.

E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
  • Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Apoiar revisões fiscais de contratos;
  • Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
  • Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
  • Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
  • Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);
  • Desejável Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Planejamento Fiscal ou Direito Tributário;

title: Lead Technical Consultant
description:

At Synamedia, we’re a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. With a legacy of protecting our long-time customers, we’re laser-focused on driving growth and leading the charge as the industry shifts from Pay-TV to IP and streaming. Our solutions, built over three decades and trusted by 1,000+ customers, fuel giants like Disney, NBA, The Olympics, Astro, Comcast, Tata Play, and many more.

Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let’s do it together!


About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant


Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.
  • Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team
  • Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.

  • Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration)
  • Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on ServiceNow ticketing tool.
  • Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.
  • Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.
  • Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.
  • Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.
  • A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.
  • Stay on top of customer reported issues, regularly communicate with customers.


Technical Skills:

  • Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent Linux Systems Administrator.
  • Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).
  • Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.G., Red Hat Cluster.
  • Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (vSphere and vCenter) would be advantageous
  • Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.
  • Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols
  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols HTTP, FTP.
  • Proven SQL scripting skills.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.
  • Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.
  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.



Qualifications, Experience and Personnal skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Customer focused
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient


Growth Opportunities

When welcoming new talent into the team, we are always looking for opportunities to bring in new ideas, those who ask challenging questions and have the curiosity to learn. These qualities are important to us as we nurture a culture of innovation, seize more opportunities to partner with our customers and make a difference as we transform the future of video. To further support your growth and that of our talent pool, Synamedia offers an exhaustive library of skill enhancement resources from AWS, SkillSoft and other partners to help you upskill while on the job. Be it data analytics that piques your brain or content creation, there’s something for every kind of mind.


Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Competitive pay hikes and bonus packages.
  • Skill enhancement and growth opportunities.
  • Equal opportunity employment.
  • Health and wellbeing programmes.

title: Development (Fundraiser) Officer
description:
The Development (Fundraiser) Officer will be responsible for mapping and applying for the possible grants and sponsorships from government laws, planning, organizing, and executing fundraising initiatives to support the mission and strategic goals of EARJ. This role requires a strong communicator with experience in data keeping and administration as well as event planning. The Officer will also work closely with the school leadership to implement effective development campaigns, foster a culture of giving, and increase community engagement.


Responsibilities:

  • Fundraising Strategy: Assist in developing and implementing a comprehensive annual fundraising plan to meet the school’s financial and development goals.
  • Campaigns & Events: Organize and coordinate fundraising events, campaigns, and initiatives, such as capital campaigns, online giving drives, auction evenings, and alumni engagement events.
  • Donor Relations: Cultivate and maintain relationships with potential and current donors, sponsors, and partners. Develop and implement donor recognition programs.
  • Research, identify, and apply for grants and sponsorship opportunities that align with the school’s mission (Ex: “Lei de incentivo ao esporte”).
  • Alumni Engagement: Work with alumni to foster lifelong connections to the school and to encourage giving.
  • Marketing & Communications: Collaborate with the marketing team to create compelling fundraising content, including newsletters, social media posts, and donor appeals.
  • Reporting & Data Management: Maintain accurate records of fundraising activities, donor contributions, and financial reports. Provide regular updates on fundraising progress to leadership.
  • Budget Management: Track and manage the fundraising budget, ensuring cost-effective planning and execution of events and initiatives.


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, or a related field.
  • English fluency is essential for this position, as communication with international stakeholders will be a core part of the role.
  • Between 1 and 3 years of experience.


*Best to have experience in fundraising, development, or a similar role, preferably in an educational or nonprofit environment. Ideally this person would understand the Brazilian Government bureaucracy regarding “Leis de incentivo”

title: Sr Product Owner
description:
At Dover Fueling Solutions (DFS), we are taking fueling and convenience retail to the next level. We are passionate about cultivating excellence in everything we do, but what really fuels us is our people. They’re the heart of our company. As an employee, our promise to you is that you’ll work on new and innovative products and solutions, be mentored by managers and teammates who are collaborative, caring, and act with integrity, and have the opportunity to grow in ways that are meaningful to you. Unique and interesting projects – both locally and globally – will challenge you and allow you to pursue different and rewarding career paths.


We are #EnergizedByGrowth.


DFS is part of a legacy of leadership that spans back generations, made up of some of the most trusted, leading-edge brands in the industry. As part of Dover Corporation and with our talented, innovative, outstanding people, we are doing great things and redefining what is possible in fueling and convenience retail. Providing advanced fuel-dispensing equipment, including clean energy solutions, systems and payment, automatic tank gauging and wet stock-management solutions, DFS comprises the product brands of Wayne Fueling Systems, OPW Fuel Management Systems, ClearView, Tokheim, ProGauge, Fairbanks, LIQAL, AvaLAN, and Bulloch Technologies. Headquartered in Austin, TX, DFS has a significant technology development and manufacturing presence worldwide, including facilities in Brazil, China, India, Italy, Poland, the Netherlands, the United Kingdom and the United Stat.


Summary

Responsible for software development projects for payment terminals and embedded media for Latin America.


Detailed Description Of The Activities

  • Rapid understanding and development of new functions in the payment software platform, DFS embedded media products.
  • Represent stakeholders during the project and monitor projects with customers (internal and/or external).
  • Organize and plan the product backlog, conducting meetings with stakeholders to prioritize the items to be developed whenever necessary.
  • Responsible for the decisions of which teamwork will maximize the value of the product and add more to those involved, sets goals, prioritizes and approves quality, always seeking to ensure the highest return on investment.
  • Maintain the agile management principles followed by the team, supporting the Scrum processes with the team (daily, planning, review and retrospective), Kanban and other applicable methods.
  • Assist the commercial teams in the presentation of existing or new products, understanding of new demands and support in the generation of commercial proposals for specific new projects or improvements in existing projects, and should support the other areas of the company in the preparation of equipment and specific versions for demonstrations, fairs and presentations.
  • Prepare reports so that everyone is aligned on the status of developments, according to the processes and frameworks used by DFS for project management and new product development.
  • Coordinate SW releases to the field and provide support afterwards.
  • Train internal and external support teams, as well as DFS manufacturing areas in new products or versions that generate significant changes.
  • Create, maintain and disseminate the KPIs of the area.
  • Promote innovation, review and continuous improvement of the team's processes seeking process improvements, reduction of operating costs and maintenance of systems.
  • Document and assist in the implementation of processes that support the manufacturing, testing and quality control process of the equipment that involves our software/hardware solutions.
  • Monitor and support internal and external audit processes (ISO).
  • Support customers of projects involving our payment platform in certification processes with card brands and networks, including PCI, EMV, etc.
  • Perform other related tasks, at the discretion of the immediate superior.


Instruction

Complete higher education in Computer Engineering or related areas.


Specific Knowledge

  • Advanced/fluent English and Spanish;
  • Programming language: C# and XML;
  • Knowledge of cryptography;
  • Device connection (TCP, Serial, etc);
  • Knowledge of network (wired, wireless, routers, etc.);
  • Domain in Agile/Scrum methodologies.


Desirable

  • Jira;

  • Support customers of projects involving our payment platform in certification processes with card brands and networks, including PCI, EMV, etc;
    .

Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.

Para este cargo, você precisará:

title: Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer
description:
Position Summary

CMG is seeking a Senior Staff Reservoir Simulation Engineer to join our Customer Success and Consulting team. This is a full-time, permanent position. As part of the growing costumer success and consulting team, the successful candidate will play an active role in delivering high quality consulting, support and training services to end users and customers of CMG in a global setting.

CMG is a worldwide leader in its field, thanks to its great staff who consistently deliver superior technology and unparalleled customer service.


Essential Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work as part of the Customer Success and Consulting team, under the direction of a Team Lead – CSC.


The successful candidate will:

  • Become very proficient with CMG’s software suite, including the graphical pre- and post-processor.
  • Play an active role in supporting CMG clients who use the software for a variety of challenging and leading-edge petroleum reservoir recovery processes.
  • Teach advanced reservoir simulation training courses to CMG clients.
  • Become part of an international consulting team and work on conventional, unconventional, thermal, chemical, compositional and energy transition reservoir studies.
  • Will get an opportunity to develop broad knowledge and expertise in simulating various enhanced oil and gas recovery processes.
  • Develop knowledge and expertise in emerging energy transition topics such as subsurface and wellbore modelling of CCS/CO2 Sequestration, geothermal, hydrogen storage, etc.
  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to junior engineers within the reservoir simulation team.
  • Act as a subject matter expert in reservoir simulation, providing guidance and expertise on complex projects and challenging technical issues.
  • Take a lead role in engaging with clients, understanding their needs, and providing high-level technical support and expertise.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor and consultant on reservoir simulation matters. Lead and oversee multiple reservoir simulation projects simultaneously, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, and to the client's satisfaction.
  • Coordinate with internal teams, including software development, technical support, and sales, to ensure seamless project execution and delivery.


The above statements are intended only to describe the general nature of the job and should not be construed as an all-inclusive list of position responsibilities.


Education

Civil Engineering, Petroleum Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Geology post-secondary degree or related graduate or post-graduate degree.


Knowledge & Skills

  • This is a technical role that will require a good understanding of reservoir engineering concepts, enhanced recovery methods and reservoir simulation concepts.
  • Experience in advanced processes such as enhanced oil recovery (EOR) or emerging energy transition processes an asset.
  • Excellent technical and communication skills and a collaborative approach towards clients and colleagues.
  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated, results focused team player with a positive attitude and ability to multi-task in a dynamic work environment.
  • Ability to clearly advise clients on technical matters.
  • Excellent public speaking and presentation skills.
  • Familiarity with state-of-the-art engineering software.
  • Hands-on experience with CMG simulation software or any other reservoir simulator an asset.
  • Require minimal supervision and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.
  • Working proficiency of company standard MS Windows and associated office productivity software tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • All applicants must be legally entitled to live and work in Brazil.
  • Be customer focused, learn about the business to help bring value to our customers.
  • Team focused with a positive attitude, must be self-motivated, and have very good time management and communication skills both in written and verbal English.


Experience

  • Minimum of 15 years of experience is required.


No need to call us about the status of your application. We promise—we’re reviewing every submission, and if your skills are a match, you’ll hear from us!

We kindly request that external recruiters and agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited resumes or candidate profiles. Submissions without a signed agreement in place will not be considered and will become the property of CMG.


About Us

Innovators in Simulation Technology

CMG (TSX:CMG) is a global software and consulting company that combines science and technology with deep industry expertise to solve complex subsurface and surface challenges for the new energy industry around the world. CMG is headquartered in Calgary, AB, with offices in Houston, London, Dubai, Bogota, Rio de Janeiro, Bengaluru, and Kuala Lumpur. For more information, please visit

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.


Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.


Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.


Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.


Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.


Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.


Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.


Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.


Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office;
    CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.


Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.


Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.


Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.


HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.


We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.


Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.


Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

Fulkrum

- Atuar na evolução de plataformas de experimentação (offline e online), desde o discovery até a operação contínua em escala;

- Acompanhar a resolução de problemas e bugs, atuando como referência técnica na análise e solução de incidentes;

- Identificar possíveis problemas, impactos em modelos/protótipos e conexões com outros sistemas existentes, promovendo governança técnica e mitigação de riscos;

- Acompanhar os KPIs referentes à entrega do projeto e posterior operação, propondo ações corretivas e melhorias contínuas;

- Metodologias de desenvolvimento ágil (Scrum e Kanban) e tradicionais (PMBOK);

- Capacidade de administrar times multidisciplinares em torno de uma agenda estratégica de experimentação e inovação;

- Modelagem de dados e arquitetura orientada a dados;

- Ferramentas de gestão de projetos e documentação técnica;

- Estratégias de transformação digital e modernização de sistemas legados;

- Gestão de stakeholders complexos e comunicação estratégica com executivos;

- Frameworks de governança de experimentação e definição de métricas organizacionais de sucesso;

- Sistemas de recomendação e personalização baseados em experimentação (Next Best Action / Offer);

- Familiaridade com ferramentas de automação e IA aplicadas ao ciclo de desenvolvimento de software;

- Graduação Completa em Engenharia da Computação, Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia da Informação, Engenharia de Software, Administração com ênfase em Sistemas de Informação, Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas.

Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Senior Installation Analysis Engineer
description:
Job Overview:

The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer uses best practices and knowledge of internal or external issues to improve the Installation Analysis discipline within McDermott. They will act as a resource for colleagues with less experience and share their conceptual and practical expertise related to the Installation Analysis discipline. The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer solves complex problems and uses discipline-specific knowledge to improve their products or services. The Senior Installation Analysis Engineer impacts a range of customer, operational, project, or service activities with the Installation Analysis team and other related teams and ensures they work within the appropriate guidelines and policies.



Key Tasks and Responsibilities:

  • Perform conceptual, FEED, and detailed design as per design basis, project specifications, design codes, and standards
  • Direct Engineering team when assigned as a Project Coordinator on projects
  • Apply knowledge and skills to a wide range of standard and nonstandard situations
  • Prepare clear and accurate detailed design calculations and analyses including design reports and procedures
  • Manage own time to meet agreed deadlines and budgets and develop plans for short-term work activities in own area
  • Communicate and explain complex issues and work to establish understanding
  • Provide engineering support onboard installation vessels offshore, when required to do so
  • Be fully familiar with the project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and all inter-discipline requirements;
    including identifying concerns as early as practicable and taking appropriate initiatives to address the issues
  • Identify changes to scope and promptly raise change notifications, including providing any necessary supporting documentation and estimates Provide similar support for Variation Orders
  • Interface with all disciplines to develop clash free designs
  • Interface with other departments to obtain input for discipline designs and drawings
  • Maintain close cooperation with other engineering disciplines, Planning, Fabrication, Marine, and Project Management Teams, as required
  • Document substantive communications (communications that result in significant decisions or assignment of actions) and forward copies to the Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in the preparation of estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and workhour estimates
  • Raise technical queries to obtain missing information, clarify work scope, and maintain preferred McDermott procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements
  • Prepare Discipline engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications, as required
  • Participate in finalizing deliverables lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity
  • Attend project review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys, as required
  • Provide technical direction and review of Designers producing products related to Construction/Installation Support Engineering
  • Prepare and review design reports
  • Assist in providing necessary design inputs to other disciplines to enable them to proceed with their deliverables
  • When assigned, assist procurement personnel in producing Discipline equipment, materials, and services;
    ensuring that work produced complies with customer objectives and procedures Procurement assistance includes preparing and reviewing requisitions, evaluating technical quotations and preparing queries, compiling bid tabulations and recommendations, preparing purchase requisitions, and coordinating with Procurement to expedite vendor documents, as directed by Discipline Lead Engineer
  • Assist in updating weight report based on receipt of vendor information
  • Check engineering performed by others within the Discipline
  • Perform design verification through single-discipline check/inter-discipline check (IDC)
  • Provide technical support to all fabrication queries, including identifying defect/rectification requirements
  • Keep the Lead engineer apprised of all activities and concerns, technical, budgetary, and manpower related
  • Assist in providing inputs for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports including associated productivity
  • Participate in internal, Customer, and third-party technical audits on engineering deliverables and vendor documents
  • Assist Lead engineer with responses to Customers and other agencies (such as certifying authorities, auditors, third parties, etc.) on their review and approval
  • Capture lessons learned and enter into MDR’s Lessons Learned system
  • Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience
  • Guide less experienced engineers on MDR and Discipline procedures, standards, worksheets, design calculations, software, requisitions, technical bid evaluations, technical queries, etc.
  • Be aware of costs related to own work and of the discipline
  • In the Pipeline installation discipline, perform/review Pipeline Installation Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for transportation and installation:
  • Submarine pipelines
  • Risers
  • Spools
  • PLETS and manifolds
  • Cables
  • In the Structural Installation discipline, perform/review Structural Installation Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures for loadout, transportation, and installation of offshore structures, including barge upgrades/modifications
  • In the Naval Installation discipline, perform /review Naval Architecture Engineering designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures related to all aspects of marine operations covering loadout, transportation, and installation
  • Additional skills (preferred, not mandatory) - perform/review designs, analyses, evaluations, calculations, and procedures such as:
  • Erection sequences for jackets, topsides, and other structures
  • Loadout procedures and guidance during the operations
  • Construction lift analyses and procedures for activities such as floatover, stackings roll-ups, etc.
  • Weighing procedures
  • Design and detailing of miscellaneous fabrication yard items
  • Crane arrangements and rigging arrangements
  • Trailer arrangements/operations, including drawings and procedures

Reports to: Discipline Lead Engineer

Liaise With: All Engineering disciplines, Fabrication Group, Safety Dept, Document Control, Procurement Group,

Subcontractors, Project Management Team, Vendors, and Customers

Supervises: Engineers


Essential Qualifications and Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Naval Architecture, Civil/Structural/Mechanical Engineering (Master's degree preferred)
  • 8-15 years of experience in oil and gas with a major contractor or consultant predominantly performing construction and installation design
  • Strong working knowledge of many design techniques and analysis methods, and detailed knowledge of the content and application of standards codes and guidelines as applicable for onshore and offshore construction
  • Preferably Registered Professional Engineer or member of a professional engineering society

Desafio da Posição

Você será responsável por liderar, estruturar e evoluir o SOC , garantindo excelência em detecção, análise, resposta e contenção de incidentes de segurança. Fará a gestão de uma operação 24x7, com times multidisciplinares (Blue Team, Threat Hunting, CTI, DFIR) e ambientes complexos (TI + OT + Cloud).

É uma posição estratégica, com alto impacto e interface direta com o CISO e clientes.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar a operação do SOC 24x7 e garantir SLAs, KPIs, MTTD/MTTR.
  • Gerenciar equipes de analistas, engenheiros e especialistas (Threat Hunting, CTI, DFIR).
  • Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para incidentes críticos.
  • Conduzir investigações avançadas, resposta a incidentes e exercícios de resiliência (tabletop, Purple Team).
  • Evoluir regras de detecção, automações e integrações de SIEM/SOAR/EDR/XDR/NDR.
  • Garantir visibilidade e monitoramento em ambientes Cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) e OT.
  • Elaborar relatórios executivos, métricas e análises baseadas em frameworks como MITRE ATT&CK, NIST e ISO 27001.
  • Atuar junto a fornecedores, clientes e áreas internas como NOC, Engenharia e GRC.
  • Apoiar times comerciais em pré-vendas técnicas de cibersegurança.


Requisitos

  • Experiência sólida liderando SOCs, operações 24x7 e Blue Team.
  • Vivência com SIEM (Elastic, QRadar, Sentinel, Splunk) e SOAR.
  • Forte domínio de EDR/XDR, NDR, IDS/IPS e firewalls.
  • Experiência em Resposta a Incidentes e DFIR.
  • Conhecimento de ambientes Windows, Linux, Active Directory e hardening.
  • Experiência com Cloud Security (AWS/Azure/GCP).
  • Entendimento de ambientes OT/ICS e Purdue Model.
  • Experiência com scripting (Python, PowerShell, Bash).


Diferenciais

  • Experiência em Threat Hunting avançado, CTI, detecção comportamental.
  • Atuação em setores regulados (financeiro, energia, saúde, manufatura).
  • Certificações como CISSP, CISM, GCIH, GCFA, GCIA, CEH, GICSP.
  • Certificações cloud (AWS Security, Azure AZ-500, Google PCSE).
  • Conhecimentos em Zero Trust, SASE/SSE, CNAPP.

title: Especialista De Modelagem Hidráulica Pleno

A Aegea

Criada em 2010, a Aegea é líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Em cada município onde atua, leva mais saúde e qualidade de vida para a população, respeitando sempre o meio ambiente e a cultura local.


Programa Respeito dá o Tom

O programa nasceu com a meta de espelhar a demografia da população brasileira no quadro de funcionários da empresa.

Em 2022 a Aegea emitiu um título sustentável atrelado a metas que incluem alcançar 45% de mulheres e 27% de negros em cargos de liderança até 2030, sendo pioneira em se comprometer com meta de diversidade racial em cargos de liderança.


A Aegea tem o compromisso com a promoção de um ambiente de trabalho mais igualitário, diverso e inclusivo, e estimula o respeito e a valorização das diferenças.

Aqui, todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados no processo seletivo, independentemente de raça, gênero, orientação sexual, religião, naturalidade, nacionalidade, deficiência, idade ou outras características.


Principais Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir autonomamente estudos hidráulicos para sistemas de abastecimento de água e esgotamento sanitário.
  • Elaborar e validar documentação técnica de estudos internos e de terceiros.
  • Desenvolver análises, cenários críticos e estudos de ampliação em sistemas de água e esgoto.
  • Executar e validar calibrações de modelos hidráulicos com base em dados monitorados.
  • Participar da análise de viabilidade econômica de soluções técnicas de infraestrutura.
  • Atuar em demandas de novos negócios da companhia, com foco técnico na modelagem.
  • Integrar informações de campo e dados geoespaciais (GIS) aos modelos.

title: General Manager Operations
description:
About the Company

Hello! Welcome to Plaza Premium Group, we're people passionate about "Making Travel Better". We are a global company with team members from all walks of life, together we are #PPGFamily, together we are building a legacy. You don't need to be from this industry, you do need to be passionate.



Our promise to you:


-We will respect and value your background and perspectives

-We will work together with integrity

-We will share our incredible pride for job, company, and industry


What we ask of you:


-Bring passion to all that you do

-Listen, move fast and think innovatively

-Speak up, have ideas, and share them

-Believe in customer service, and treating every person with kindness


As industry leaders in innovating global airport hospitality, you will work with colleagues from all parts of the world for a truly global experience. You will help and craft services and facilities in over 200 locations in more than 60 international airports across the world.


Who we are:


We were established in HK in 1998 by someone who understood the value of an airport lounge and felt that the experience shouldn't just be limited to a closed-circuit group of travellers. Through the years we have worked incredibly hard to create an experience that is both accessible and quality. Almost 26 years later we now span four core business segments: airport lounges, airport terminal hotels, airport meet & greet services, and a range of airport dining concepts. In addition to our own brands, PPG provides airport hospitality solutions to leading airlines, alliances, and corporates around the world. Here are a few names you might recognize: Cathay Pacific Airways, Singapore Airlines, Lufthansa, etc.


With the future of travel always insight, we created Smart Traveller, a mobile-app rewards program underpinned by in-house technology. We are fast-moving and always evolving to drive our purpose of making travel better.


Join our family today.

Together, we'll make travel better.


About the job:


The General Manager of Operations is accountable for overseeing the entire operational ecosystem for Plaza Premium within the Rio de Janeiro airport system. This leadership role ensures that all guest touchpoints deliver the highest standards of quality, efficiency, and hospitality, providing an exceptional experience for every traveller. The General Manager of Operations is responsible for operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and guest satisfaction across all services.


Operational Management:

  • Oversee daily operations across Plaza Premium Group portfolio. including partner lounges
  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve operational policies and procedures tailored to Plaza Premium Group within the Rio de Janeiro airport system, enhancing guest experience and operational efficiency.
  • Monitor and analyse performance metrics for all services, identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing corrective actions
  • Ensure full compliance with Brazilian regulatory requirements and company policies, including, labour laws, health &safety, and airports standards.
  • Coordinate with other departments to guarantee integrated operations and outstanding guest satisfaction.
  • Own the customer experience and Net Promoter Score (NPS) across all customer touch points.


Financial Management:

  • Accountable for the P&L, budgeting, forecasting and cost control within the Rio de Janeiro airport system
  • Responsible for hiring, training and engagement.


Job Requirements:


  • Bachelor’s degree in business, hospitality, real estate, or related field (MBA is plus)
  • Fluency in Portuguese and English (mandatory);
    Spanish is a plus.
  • 10+ years of experience in senior management, experience in hotels, airport operations & hospitality is an advantage
  • Preference to have a track record in managing multi-service operations within airports or similar industries
  • Proven ability to build long-term partnerships with clients
  • Strong understanding of airport infrastructure and regulatory environments in Central & South America (is a plus)
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and financial acumen
  • Willingness to travel frequently within the region
  • Demonstrates exceptional interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence & empathy

title: Financial Controller
description:
Financial Controller – Brazil

Location: Rio de Janeiro

Employment Type: Permanent | Full-time



Role Overview

A global financial services organisation is seeking a qualified Financial Controller to take full ownership of statutory, management, and operational finance for its Brazil entity. This is a standalone senior finance role with end-to-end accountability for financial control, regulatory compliance, reporting accuracy, systems optimisation, and cross-border financial governance.


The position operates as the primary financial authority for Brazil, acting as the key interface with global finance leadership, external auditors, tax authorities, and regional stakeholders. The role requires deep technical accounting expertise within a regulated, multi-currency, international environment , alongside hands-on ownership of financial systems, controls, and transformation initiatives.


Key Responsibilities

  • Full ownership of end-to-end finance operations for the Brazil entity, covering general ledger, AP, AR, fixed assets, cash and balance sheet integrity.
  • Production of accurate and timely monthly management accounts, including detailed variance analysis, KPI reporting and financial performance commentary.
  • End-to-end responsibility for statutory reporting, including preparation and submission of annual financial statements and all federal and state tax filings.
  • Ownership of the month-end and year-end close process, including journals, reconciliations, balance sheet substantiation and audit readiness.
  • Development, implementation and ongoing monitoring of internal controls to ensure compliance with group policies, local regulation and audit standards.
  • Lead the full external audit process, acting as primary point of contact for auditors and resolving technical accounting and control issues.
  • Oversight of transfer pricing, intercompany accounting and international tax compliance in partnership with central tax teams.
  • Drive finance process improvement, automation and system optimisation across record-to-report, procure-to-pay and order-to-cash cycles.
  • Lead initiatives to reduce close timelines, improve working capital efficiency and enhance cash flow forecasting accuracy.
  • Act as finance lead for strategic projects including business growth, restructuring, system upgrades, new entity launches and M&A activity.


Key Requirements (Technical Only)

  • Fully qualified accountant: CRC, CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA or international equivalent .
  • Proven experience in financial control, controllership or senior finance leadership within a regulated, multi-entity environment.
  • Strong technical knowledge of US GAAP and international accounting standards (IFRS / local GAAP) .
  • Demonstrated experience leading statutory reporting, audit management and regulatory compliance .
  • Track record of operating in multi-currency and cross-border finance environments .
  • Hands-on experience with financial systems and ERP platforms (Workday or equivalent).
  • Practical experience with transfer pricing, intercompany accounting and international tax compliance .
  • Background in financial services, professional services, or other regulated industries .
  • Experience supporting international entities or regional finance operations across multiple jurisdictions.

title: Tech Lead - .Net E Angular
description:

Localização: Escritório Central I Rio de Janeiro

Estamos selecionando um(a) Tech Lead (.NET & Angular) para atuar em um projeto estratégico em um de nossos principais clientes, uma empresa de alta complexidade e missão crítica no setor de Energia.

Procuramos um profissional Sênior que queira assumir um papel de liderança técnica, sendo a principal ponte entre as áreas de Negócio e os times de desenvolvimento (fábrica).

Seu papel não será o desenvolvimento "hands-on" diário, mas sim a governança técnica, o relacionamento com stakeholders e a orientação da equipe. Você será a referência que entende profundamente da tecnologia para definir soluções, mas também atuará no "incêndio", colocando a mão na massa quando incidentes críticos exigirem sua expertise técnica.


Principais responsabilidades:

Interface de negócio: Ser o canal de comunicação principal com as áreas usuárias, realizando o levantamento de requisitos e traduzindo as necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas viáveis.

Governança técnica: Orientar a fábrica de software, questionar soluções, validar estimativas e garantir a qualidade das entregas e a aderência à arquitetura definida.

Análise e solução: Atuar na análise inicial de problemas e novas implementações, propondo soluções e depurando sistemas em cenários complexos.

Gestão de crise (Hands-on pontual): Liderar a resolução de problemas críticos em produção, atuando tecnicamente quando necessário.

Gestão de esteira: Supervisionar e entender o processo de build e deploy, gestão de branchs e a administração da esteira de CI/CD (incluindo ambientes em OpenShift ).


Requisitos essenciais (Obrigatórios):

Experiência consolidada (mínimo 5 anos ) em desenvolvimento, arquitetura ou liderança técnica.

Profundo conhecimento e experiência prática em C# .NET (Core e Framework) e Angular.

Sólidos conhecimentos em Modelagem de Banco de Dados (preferencialmente SQL Server) e linguagem SQL.

Experiência em metodologias ágeis e tradicionais de desenvolvimento.

Vivência anterior atuando como interface direta com usuários ou áreas de negócio (levantamento de requisitos, definição de escopo).

Inglês Intermediário para leitura e escrita de documentação técnica.


Diferenciais (Desejáveis):

Conhecimento em Mensageria (principalmente Kafka ).

Vivência com ambientes de containers (preferencialmente OpenShift, Docker ou Kubernetes ).

Conhecimento em Arquitetura de TI e Integração de Sistemas.

Pós-graduação na área de Tecnologia.

title: Analista De Reforma Tributária Sênior
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.


A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls, em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.


Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Realizar o mapeamento dos impactos da Reforma Tributária (CBS e IBS) sobre as atividades do grupo;
  • Elaborar análises, simulações, comparativos e relatórios;
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento dos novos campos das notas fiscais de saídas, contabilização, apuração assistida, recolhimento e da configuração dos sistemas (ERP e satélites);
  • Participar da definição e do preenchimento das novas regras de creditamento sobre as notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Apoiar revisõesfiscais de contratos;
  • Propor melhorias operacionais e apoiar a implantação de controles, automações e validações fiscais, assegurando o cumprimento das obrigações acessórias e a mitigação de riscos tributários;
  • Atuar com diferentes interfaces e áreas, orientando e promovendo alinhamento, atualizações e adequações de processos;
  • Atendimento à fiscalização e auditoria;
  • Acompanhar a legislação complementar e as regulamentações federais, estaduais e municipais relacionadas à Reforma Tributária.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Formação superior em Direito ou Ciências Contábeis;
  • Domínio dos tributos indiretos (ICMS, ISS, PIS, COFINS) e conhecimento dos novos modelos (CBS, IBS);
  • Desejável Pós-graduação ou especialização em Tributação, Planejamento Fiscal ou Direito Tributário;
  • Conhecimento emsistemas fiscais e ERPs SAP Diferencial.

  • Reviews incoming financial aid application and any supporting documentation needed to determine the accuracy of the financial and household information reported on the FAFSA.   • Complete assigned duties with a high degree of accuracy to ensure compliance while experiencing multiple interruptions.
  • Exercise great attention to detail when completing assignments as error in judgment or calculations could result in unintended consequences for the student and/or the institution such as under or over funding of a student, loss of student eligibility, audit findings, fines, damage to school’s reputation or loss of institutional eligibility.
  • Will have the authority to recalculate and makes changes to financial aid awards when student’s eligibility changes.
  • Maintain knowledge of federal, state and institutional policies as it relates to the awarding and disbursements of federal, state and institutional aid.
  • Assists with the oversight of the administration of both the federal and private loans. This includes the certification of private education loans, resolving issues between the university’s system and the Dept. of Educations. Participation in state, regional and national professional development activities to ensure a complete understanding of federal and state regulations and remain current on changes to the federal and state aid programs.
  • Must utilize conflict resolution skill set to pacify disgruntled students and parents, helping them to understand the situation and identify potential solutions to issues.
  • Maintain student confidentiality in accordance with FERPA regulations.
  • Ensures that students are receiving Exit Counseling information upon withdrawal, graduation or dropping below half time.

  • Assist the management and other office staff in special project assignments;
  • Participates incommittees under the direction of the Manager of Financial Aid counselors to review Satisfactory Academic Progress (SAP) appeals, Professional Judgment requests, and Howard University Scholarship appeals, as needed.

  • Other duties as assigned by the financial aid director/associate director and/or Manager of Financial Aid Counselors.

CORE COMPETENCIES:

  • Proficiency in technology and the systems used to determine student’s eligibility and originate a financial aid award. (These may include but not limited to: Banner, NSLDS, COD, CPS, ELM, MS, School Servicing Center, Campus Logic, Word, Excel, etc.)
